page: Vultr vx1-m-64c-512g-3840s is a memory-optimized server belonging to the VX1 Cloud Compute family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled as a 3840 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. No GPUs are present in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple domains. The AMD EPYC processor achieves top 10% placement in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU and physics evaluations. Memory subsystem performance is highly efficient, with uncached large-block read and write bandwidths ranking in the top 10%. In application-specific workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations. It also shows strong top 25% performance in static web serving and Redis SET operations.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the substantial 3840 GB local NVMe storage, this server is designed for memory-intensive and data-heavy workloads. It is highly suitable for hosting large-scale databases, executing complex ETL pipelines, running software compilation suites, and performing memory-bound simulations. The dedicated CPU allocation and high resource density offer a stable, predictable environment, delivering favorable qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-grade deployments requiring substantial memory and fast local storage without the overhead of GPU hardware.
